body:
Founder real-time: 'make it so that the fireball ignites the enemies it touches making them have burning too' -> 'via parena mods' -> 'make the fireball move just a bit faster'. Reused the existing generic on_hit_burn_ms/on_hit_burn_dps ArenaProjectile mechanic (same one Pizza/Flute Debt/Tyler's Q already use) -- the per-hit resolution code already runs once per enemy a piercing shot passes through, so setting two fields at spawn was the whole change, no new plumbing. Burn duration/DPS match Pizza's own Q burn (3000ms/5dps), a real established baseline not invented fresh. Confirmed 'via parena mods' already holds -- the burn fields are set in the same host function (redgarden_host_abraham_fireball_cast) the real compiled PARENA mod (on_abraham_fireball_cast) already calls into, no bypass. Fireball speed bumped 3.0->4.0 (now matches hero move speed exactly). Verified via a direct headless repro before touching tests: burn applies at impact and ticks correctly to expiry. New test added. Full 1101-check suite green, real mingw cross-compile verified.

⚓ ☃
title: Abraham fireball now ignites enemies (burn DoT) + slightly faster travel
